activity.title: Your listening
activity.intro: Actual playback time, excluding pauses, seeking and startup. Everything stays on this PC.
activity.privateHint: Stops saving new listening activity and recent plays. Turning this on removes the current session; earlier sessions are kept.
activity.localHint: Retention applies to measured sessions. Earlier history is separate; you can clear both here.
activity.recentHint: Last 100 sessions; the summary covers the full retention period.
activity.confirmHint: Remove measured sessions, history and recent plays. Favourites, playlists and followed albums stay saved. The next play will start a new session.
activity.emptyHint: Play a track to measure actual listening time. Searching or queuing does not count as listening.
activity.privateEmptyHint: New sessions are not recorded. Turn off private listening to start measuring again.
activity.legacy: {count} starts from earlier history have no measured duration and are not included in these totals.
activity.completionHint: “Reached the end” means the player reached the end, even after a seek. Future recommendations use actual listening time; the first replay within 30 minutes carries less weight, and further replays add no weight.

taste.homeHint: Discover what you listen to most and create a mix from your tracks.

taste.trackGenres: Genres of tracks you listen to
taste.summary: {sessions} eligible sessions · {minutes} actual minutes · {unknown}% without an assigned genre
taste.coldStart: Your profile is taking shape: it needs at least 3 eligible sessions and 3 actual minutes. Meanwhile, mixes start from your favourites and playlists.
taste.private: Private session active: new plays do not enter your profile. Searching for new candidates is paused.
taste.noArtists: Listen to a few tracks: the artists you return to will appear here.
taste.noGenres: No confirmed genre at this level. On artist or album pages, or in track options, confirm iTunes metadata or add personal genres.
taste.methodHint: We count actual listening time, with a bonus for reaching the end after hearing at least 75%. Skips before 30 seconds and 25% reduce weight. A play loses half its weight every 14 days; quick replays carry less weight. Errors and interruptions are not negative feedback. Favourites, playlist saves and your feedback give separate bonuses, without multiplying duplicates.
taste.genreHint: Genres come only from metadata you have confirmed or entered. The artist view divides weight between credited artists; the track view uses only that track's genres. An artist's genre is not automatically assigned to every track.
taste.privateHint: Private listening, excluded sessions and simple starts from earlier history do not feed the profile. The period is limited by retention in listening settings.
taste.mixHint: Up to 20 tracks, an order prepared for today and clear explanations.
taste.remoteHint: {count} local candidates. The button sends the catalogue up to three artist names from your listening or favourites, not your full history. Results stay cached for 30 days. Search never starts automatically and does not guarantee unheard tracks.
taste.moreNotice: Preference saved: this track and artist will carry more weight in recommendations.
taste.lessNotice: Track excluded from mixes. You can undo this below; other tracks by the same artist remain available.
taste.whyLiked: Because it is in your favourites
taste.whySaved: Because you saved it to a playlist
taste.whyListened: Because you return to it in your actual listening
taste.whyArtist: For an artist you listen to or like: {detail}
taste.emptyMix: Not enough candidates for this mix yet
taste.emptyGenre: Confirm genres on catalogue pages. Genre search results alone do not classify a track.
taste.emptyHint: Save or play tracks, find new candidates or include the last 24 hours. Artist limits and exclusions may shorten the mix; they are always respected.
taste.discovered: Search complete: {added} candidates added · {failed} searches not refreshed. Previous cached results remain available.
taste.resetHint: The profile will restart from plays after this moment. Feedback, discovery candidates and mixes will be removed. History, favourites, playlists, metadata and player exclusions remain; favourites can still seed new mixes.
taste.resetDone: Profile restarted. New plays will build your taste profile.
taste.noFeedback: Use the thumbs beside tracks to shape your mixes. You can always undo a choice here.
